content: SWR: ~5.3kB, single-hook API, revalidate-on-focus and polling are built-in defaults, minimal config. TanStack Query: ~16.2kB, richer cache/mutation/devtools system, refetchInterval pauses in background tab unless refetchIntervalInBackground:true. Both compose with any typed fetcher including openapi-fetch; no official openapi-fetch-specific integration docs found, wrapping the generated client function as the SWR/Query fetcher is the standard approach.
